additions.group: 統合マルチモーダル生成・検索・構造化判断
additions.reason_selected: Independently trained MGVB/ULKD/SEMO unified generation, embedding and structured-decision model with mandatory unimodel_aux.safetensors. Unlike separate Qwen3 Embedding, Intern-Decision, Ivonnet, IVE and Kanana, shared backbone supports all three task modes. 4B creator cross-task comparison supports research; 2B separately trained but same mechanism held pending matched low-memory comparison.
additions.quality_positive: Publisher unified 4B HCD 65.1% at about 8 GB BF16 weights vs separate combinations 64.2–64.8% at 21–43 GB; rounded weight-only comparison, not peak RAM.
additions.quality_negative: No matched independent comparison against current incumbent bundle; publisher aggregate can hide individual regressions, no owner latency/memory/calibration evidence.
additions.risk_and_alternative_assessment: Mandatory aux and pinned custom code, runtime and third-party rights not closed; no risk-based acquisition priority.
additions.license_metadata: Apache-2.0; third-party terms remain applicable; individual acts and dependency rights unverified

Preserve as one research bundle, not separate registered draft or quant copies. Complements rather than displaces LightOnOCR, PaddleOCR and DeepSeek OCR.

additions.quality_negative: Single-pass 72.74 below incumbent LightOnOCR-3-0.8B 74.60; multi-pass pipeline not matched standalone model comparison. Independent quality and owner ABI/latency absent.
additions.risk_and_alternative_assessment: Target stored F32, benchmark BF16; drafter optional, exact full census unresolved; no download or execution.
